title: STILL PRESENT (r2): Queued-row take-over dead-ends — the menu now offers 'Take over' (W6 fix) but the confirm surface never renders for queued rows, so the take-over can never be dispatched from the UI
location: client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:598-610 (Queued row_detail arm); 490-493 (overflow_actions); 623-631/659-667 (the only view_take_over_confirm call sites)
evidence: overflow_actions (490-493): 'Queued -> list.append([RefcheckStart, RefcheckSkip], case call.hooks.can_take_over { True -> [RefcheckTakeOver] False -> [] })' — row_detail Queued arm (600-609): 'case pending_confirm(call.reference_call_id, RefcheckConfirmStart, confirm) { True -> view_start_confirm(call, app, slot, inflight) False -> element.none() }' — view_take_over_confirm is invoked ONLY in the Unreachable arm (623-631) and ContactInitiated arm (659-667). 'grep -n view_take_over_confirm' → 631, 667 only.
detail: Clicking 'Take over' on a queued row sets RefcheckConfirmTakeOver, the menu closes, and row_detail renders element.none() — no confirm, no dispatch. The r2 W6 pin (overflow_menu_queued_lists_take_over_when_hook_test:1167) asserts only the menu entry; take_over_confirm_renders_inline_test:1283 uses a ContactInitiated row.
recommended_fix: Render the take-over confirm in the Queued arm: add a pending_confirm(call_id, RefcheckConfirmTakeOver, confirm) branch next to the start-confirm branch (mirror the ContactInitiated arm), and pin it with a queued-row confirm test.

title: STILL PRESENT (r2): the client's `?slot=` wire format for per-row start still has no test — the server 400 branch is pinned but the client URL construction is not
location: client/src/api/reference_checks_api.gleam:64-65; client/test/ (no test asserts the start URL)
evidence: reference_checks_api.gleam:64-65: 'let url = case slot { Some(s) -> url <> "?slot=" <> s None -> url }' — grep of client/test/ for 'reference-checks', '?slot=', 'start_check' finds no assertion of the built URL; the only start test (client_test.gleam:6312 refcheck_start_choice_opens_inline_confirm_test) stops at the confirm state.
detail: The r2 fix map claimed the ?slot= wire format would be tested; it wasn't. The server side is pinned (start_with_invalid_slot_returns_400_test), but a client regression (dropped/renamed query param) would pass all client tests.
recommended_fix: Add a client test asserting start_check builds POST .../reference-checks/start?slot=employer_ref for Some(slot) and .../start for None (mock the fetch layer or extract the URL builder as a pure function).

title: STILL PRESENT (r2): single-slot refcheck_edit — a second action choice or any action success still silently discards another row's in-progress typed trio (the behind-a-button and Cancel-close parts are fixed)
evidence: RefcheckSubstitute arm (3383-3390): 'refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit(model, call_id, RefcheckEditSubstitute))' — unconditional overwrite of any open edit; RefcheckCorrect arm (3395-3400): same pattern; ApiReturnedRefcheckAction success (3555-3558): 'let cleared = Model(..model, refcheck_edit: None, refcheck_confirm: None, ...)' — clears the edit even when the action targeted a different call_id.
detail: With an edit open on row A (typed, unsaved), opening row B's substitute/correct or succeeding on row B discards A's typed trio with no warning. UserCancelledRefcheckEdit now closes (fixed) and the correction surface is behind a button (fixed), but the overwrite/clear-on-other-row behavior persists.
recommended_fix: Guard UserChoseRefcheckAction: if refcheck_edit is Some for a different call_id, dismiss or confirm before replacing; and scope the success-arm clear to the acted call_id (only clear when edit.call_id == call_id).
